note: Keokuk County Conservation park on 260-acre Lake Belva Deer, ~5 mi NE of Sigourney: 56 modern sites with concrete pads in a main loop by the shower house and a herringbone row on a lane to the north, both screened from the lake by woods. 8 miles of horse trails and public hunting in the park. All county areas close to visitors at 10:30 p.m. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $20 (county FAQ), FCFS only, 14-night limit; amperage 30 -> 50 (FAQ '30amp, 50 amp ... to all sites'). Not waterfront stands. Season not stated.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands, no lead. Two pad groups: the main loop (~41.3745,-92.1357) is ~200 m+ from the lake behind woods and ponds; the north herringbone row (~41.3772,-92.1352) has its east pads ~55-80 m from the shore through unbroken forest canopy (imagery estimates, Overpass down). No campsite photos found to show a filtered view. The stored evidence was read at this pin, which sits on the main loop, so it holds.
